defmodule Forum.Archive.Preparations.ArchiveScope do
  use Ash.Resource.Preparation
  import Ash.Query

  def prepare(query, _opts, _context) do

defmodule Forum.Archive.Changes.CascadeArchive do
  use Ash.Resource.Change
  
  def change(changeset, _opts, _context) do
    if changeset.data.archived_at do
      changeset
    else
      batch_id = Ecto.UUID.generate()
      now = DateTime.utc_now()
      
      Ash.Changeset.after_action(changeset, fn _changeset, result ->
        archive_recursive(result, now, batch_id)
        {:ok, result}
      end)
      |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{archived_at: now, archive_batch_id: batch_id})
    end
  end

  defp archive_recursive(record, now, batch_id) do
    # Assuming resource relationships are defined.
    # We need to get descendants.
    case record.__struct__ do
      Forum.Content.Post ->
        load_and_archive(record, [:comments], now, batch_id)
      Forum.Content.Comment ->
        load_and_archive(record, [:reactions], now, batch_id)
      Forum.Content.Reaction ->
        :ok
    end
  end

  defp load_and_archive(record, relationships, now, batch_id) do
    record = Ash.load!(record, relationships)
    for rel <- relationships do
      for child <- Map.get(record, rel) || [] do
        unless child.archived_at do
          child
          |> Ash.Changeset.for_update(:archive, %{}) # Not ideal but fits signature
          |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{archived_at: now, archive_batch_id: batch_id})
          |> Ash.update!()
          
          archive_recursive(child, now, batch_id)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

defmodule Forum.Archive.Changes.CascadeRestore do
  use Ash.Resource.Change

  def change(changeset, _opts, _context) do
    if is_nil(changeset.data.archived_at) do
      changeset
    else
      batch_id = changeset.data.archive_batch_id
      
      Ash.Changeset.after_action(changeset, fn _changeset, result ->
        restore_recursive(result, batch_id)
        {:ok, result}
      end)
      |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{archived_at: nil, archive_batch_id: nil})
    end
  end

  defp restore_recursive(record, batch_id) do
    case record.__struct__ do
      Forum.Content.Post ->
        load_and_restore(record, [:comments], batch_id)
      Forum.Content.Comment ->
        load_and_restore(record, [:reactions], batch_id)
      Forum.Content.Reaction ->
        :ok
    end
  end

  defp load_and_restore(record, relationships, batch_id) do
    record = Ash.load!(record, relationships)
    for rel <- relationships do
      for child <- Map.get(record, rel) || [] do
        if child.archive_batch_id == batch_id do
          child
          |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{archived_at: nil, archive_batch_id: nil})
          |> Ash.update!()
          restore_recursive(child, batch_id)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

defmodule Forum.Archive.Changes.CascadePurge do
  use Ash.Resource.Change
  
  def change(changeset, _opts, _context) do
    if is_nil(changeset.data.archived_at) do
      Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, :archived_at, "must be archived before it can be purged")
    else
      Ash.Changeset.before_action(changeset, fn changeset ->
        purge_recursive(changeset.data)
        changeset
      end)
    end
  end
  
  defp purge_recursive(record) do
    # Load relationships then delete children
    case record.__struct__ do
      Forum.Content.Post ->
        load_and_purge(record, [:comments])
      Forum.Content.Comment ->
        load_and_purge(record, [:reactions])
      _ -> :ok
    end
    Ash.destroy!(record)
  end
  
  defp load_and_purge(record, relationships) do
    record = Ash.load!(record, relationships)
    for rel <- relationships do
      for child <- Map.get(record, rel) || [] do
        purge_recursive(child)
      end
    end
  end
end
